accounts.name: program
docs: S2 FIX: only the program's upgrade authority may create the Machine,
otherwise the first caller becomes machine.authority.

accounts.name: nft_xnt_pool
docs: PHASE 2: NFT staker fee pool — receives 40% of mint revenue

accounts.name: lp_xnt_pool
docs: PHASE 2: LP staker fee pool — receives 10% of mint revenue

accounts.name: season_config
docs: UNINITIALIZED account means "no active season", so mints keep working
even before set_season is ever called (no deploy-order lockout). The
seeds constraint pins the address, so only set_season can put data here.

instructions.name: refund_mint
docs: Burn 2 gumballs of rarity X → receive 1 guaranteed rarity X+1
C-1 FIX: gumball accounts validated by PDA seeds
Allow the minter to reclaim XNT if the oracle failed to reveal within MINT_TIMEOUT.
Anyone can call this after the timeout — funds always go back to the original minter.

instructions.name: refund_legacy_mint
docs: Refund a pre-upgrade 156-byte MintRequest (before `request_slot` was appended).
`Account<MintRequest>` cannot deserialize those, so reveal_and_mint and
refund_mint reject them. Anyone may call this after MINT_TIMEOUT; all lamports
go to the stored minter. Layout (incl. 8-byte discriminator): minter 8..40,
machine 40..72, commitment 72..104, quantity 104, remaining 105, paid 106..114,
requested_at 114..122, fulfilled 122, bump 123, user_seed 124..156.

accounts.name: mint_request
docs: discriminator, PDA seeds) because Account<MintRequest> cannot read it

accounts.name: nft_xnt_pool
docs: PHASE 2: NFT staker fee pool — receives 40% of upgrade fee

accounts.name: lp_xnt_pool
docs: PHASE 2: LP staker fee pool — receives 10% of upgrade fee

instructions.name: burn_multi
docs: Burn N gumballs of rarity X → receive 1 of rarity X+1
Handles Common→Uncommon (5 burns) and Uncommon→Rare (3 burns)
remaining_accounts = [(mint_1, ata_1, gumball_pda_1), (mint_2, ata_2, gumball_pda_2), ...]
gumball_a/mint_a/ata_a are the "base" accounts (first burn)

accounts.name: nft_xnt_pool
docs: PHASE 2: NFT staker fee pool — receives 40% of upgrade fee

accounts.name: lp_xnt_pool
docs: PHASE 2: LP staker fee pool — receives 10% of upgrade fee

instructions.name: migrate_machine
docs: Migrate machine account to new struct size (adds total_burned field).
Safe to call multiple times — idempotent.

instructions.name: set_season
docs: Admin: configure a seasonal trait window. While `ends_at` is in the
future, new mints draw flavor/color from the given sub-ranges of the
trait arrays (rarity odds untouched). Set ends_at = 0 to end a season
early. count = 0 leaves that trait unwindowed.

instructions.name: attach_metadata
docs: Permissionless: attach Metaplex metadata to an existing gumball NFT so
wallets display it (name + image). Name derives from on-chain serial;
the URI points at the metadata API, which serves the on-chain SVG as a
data-URI image — no off-chain storage of the artwork itself.
Anyone can pay to attach; Metaplex rejects the CPI if metadata exists.

accounts.name: gumball_data
docs: Proves this mint is a real gumball (PDA exists) + provides the serial

accounts.name: metadata_account
docs: program in the CPI; creation fails if it already exists

instructions.name: transfer_authority
docs: Transfer machine admin rights and treasury to a new key — the mainnet
path to a multisig (point both at a Squads-style multisig authority).
Irreversible unless the new authority signs a transfer back.

instructions.name: update_owner
docs: H2 FIX: Sync gumball owner to current SPL token holder.
Anyone can call this — it just reads the ATA balance and updates the field.

instructions.name: list_gumball
docs: List a gumball NFT for sale at a fixed price.
Token is escrowed in a PDA-owned ATA until sold or delisted.

instructions.name: delist_gumball
docs: Cancel a listing and return the NFT to the seller.

instructions.name: buy_gumball
docs: Buy a listed gumball. `max_price` is the most the buyer is willing to
pay, in lamports — pass the price that was displayed to them.
Without it this instruction was front-runnable. The Listing PDA address
is derived from the mint alone, so a seller who sees a buy in flight can
delist and relist at any price: the PDA is recreated at the SAME
address, the victim's instruction still resolves, and it settles at the
new price. Binding the caller's expectation is the fix.

accounts.name: nft_xnt_pool
docs: PHASE 2: NFT staker fee pool — receives 25% of royalty

accounts.name: lp_xnt_pool
docs: PHASE 2: LP staker fee pool — receives 25% of royalty

instructions.name: make_offer
docs: Place an offer on a gumball (listed or not). XNT escrowed in Offer PDA.

instructions.name: cancel_offer
docs: Cancel an offer and return escrowed XNT to buyer.
Anchor `close = buyer` handles lamport return + account cleanup.

instructions.name: accept_offer
docs: Accept an offer — seller receives XNT (minus royalty), buyer gets NFT.
`min_amount` is the least the seller is willing to accept, in lamports —
pass the amount that was displayed to them.
Mirror of the buy_gumball case: the Offer PDA is keyed by (mint, buyer),
so a buyer can cancel and re-make a smaller offer at the same address
under a pending accept_offer.

accounts.name: nft_xnt_pool
docs: PHASE 2: NFT staker fee pool — receives 25% of royalty

accounts.name: lp_xnt_pool
docs: PHASE 2: LP staker fee pool — receives 25% of royalty

instructions.name: reroll_cosmetics
docs: Burn a flat GUM fee to re-randomize a gumball's COSMETICS (flavor,
color, special) — rarity never changes. Entropy is the slot hash mixed
with a caller-supplied seed (prevents validator grinding, same model as
burns). Respects any active season window; the on-chain SVG regenerates.
This is GUM's demand sink: supply is fixed, burned GUM is gone forever.

accounts.name: owner_nft_ata
docs: Caller must actually HOLD the NFT (stronger than the tracked owner
field, and staked/escrowed gumballs can't be rerolled)

instructions.name: create_auction
docs: Start an English auction: NFT escrowed (same escrow authority as fixed-
price listings), bids escrow lamports in the Auction PDA. Duration is
bounded to 1 hour – 7 days.

instructions.name: bid
docs: Bid on a live auction. Lamports escrow in the Auction PDA; the previous
highest bidder is refunded in the same transaction. Minimum raise is 5%.
Anti-snipe: a bid in the final 5 minutes extends the auction to now+5min.

accounts.name: prev_bidder
docs: handler (any account is accepted when there is no previous bid)

instructions.name: settle_auction
docs: Settle an ended auction — permissionless (anyone can crank it).
With bids: NFT → winner, 95% → seller, 5% royalty split 50/25/25 to
treasury/NFT pool/LP pool (same routing as buy_gumball). Without bids:
NFT returns to the seller (pass seller as `winner`). Auction PDA closes
to the seller either way.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone can crank a settle; the payer covers winner-ATA rent if needed

instructions.name: initialize_staking
docs: Initialize the staking system. Stores the (already-existing, fixed-supply)
GUM mint pubkey and creates two reward-vault ATAs owned by stake_config.
The admin must transfer GUM into both vaults after init (regular SPL transfer).

accounts.name: authority
docs: HIGH-2 FIX: only the Machine.authority (the legitimate admin who deployed
the program and initialized the Machine PDA) can initialize staking.
Without this check, any wallet could front-run the admin and seize control
of stake_config.authority — bricking the staking deploy permanently.

accounts.name: gum_mint
docs: The (already-existing, fixed-supply) GUM mint. Authority should be revoked
before initialization — admin must transfer GUM into the vaults out-of-band.

accounts.name: nft_reward_vault
docs: Reward vault for NFT stakers — PDA-owned token account (admin funds via SPL transfer).

accounts.name: lp_reward_vault
docs: Reward vault for LP stakers — PDA-owned token account (admin funds via SPL transfer).

instructions.name: stake
docs: Stake a gumball NFT — transfer to vault, start earning GUM via Pattern B.

accounts.name: gumball_data
docs: The gumball data PDA — used to read rarity

accounts.name: user_ata
docs: User's NFT token account (source)

accounts.name: vault_ata
docs: Vault token account (destination) — owned by stake_config PDA

accounts.name: nft_reward_vault
docs: NFT reward vault — read for accumulator update (vault_balance term)

accounts.name: nft_xnt_state
docs: HIGH-1 FIX: XNT fee state — accumulator must advance before total_nft_weight changes.

accounts.name: nft_xnt_pool
docs: HIGH-1 FIX: XNT fee pool — lamports are only READ here (accumulator
update); no mut, so stakes don't write-lock the shared pool.

accounts.name: xnt_debt
docs: CRIT-3 FIX: per-position XNT debt initialized at stake-time so historical
accumulator value is NOT credited to this position on first claim.
init_if_needed: the PDA may survive from an unstake under the previous
deploy (which didn't close it) — we overwrite it either way.

instructions.name: claim
docs: Claim pending GUM rewards without unstaking. Pays from nft_reward_vault.

accounts.name: gum_mint
docs: The fixed-supply GUM mint — must match what's stored in stake_config

accounts.name: nft_reward_vault
docs: NFT reward vault — transfer source

accounts.name: staker_gum_ata
docs: Staker's GUM token account (destination)

instructions.name: unstake
docs: Unstake — claim final rewards and return NFT to owner. Closes StakeAccount.
Also settles any pending XNT fee share and closes the XntDebt PDA (rent
refunded to the staker; stake() re-creates it on a future re-stake).

accounts.name: vault_ata
docs: Vault token account holding the staked NFT

accounts.name: user_ata
docs: User's NFT token account (destination)

accounts.name: gum_mint
docs: The fixed-supply GUM mint

accounts.name: nft_reward_vault
docs: NFT reward vault — final reward source

accounts.name: staker_gum_ata
docs: Staker's GUM token account for final rewards

accounts.name: nft_xnt_state
docs: HIGH-1 FIX: XNT fee state — accumulator must advance before total_nft_weight shrinks.

accounts.name: nft_xnt_pool
docs: XNT pool — settles any pending XNT to the staker on unstake, then we update last_seen.

accounts.name: xnt_debt
docs: XntDebt is settled then CLOSED on unstake (rent back to staker);
init_if_needed covers legacy positions that never had one.

instructions.name: stake_lp
docs: Stake LP tokens with a lock tier. lock_tier: 0=Flexible, 1=Bronze (30d),
2=Silver (90d), 3=Gold (180d), 4=Diamond (365d).
Mints a tradeable position NFT — whoever holds it controls the position.

accounts.name: position_mint
docs: Position NFT mint — created fresh for each new position

accounts.name: position_ata
docs: Position NFT ATA for the staker

accounts.name: lp_mint
docs: B3 FIX: only the LP mint registered via set_lp_mint may be staked.

accounts.name: lp_reward_vault
docs: LP reward vault — read for accumulator update

accounts.name: lp_xnt_state
docs: HIGH-1 FIX: XNT fee state for LP — accumulator must advance before total_lp_weight grows.

accounts.name: lp_xnt_pool
docs: HIGH-1 FIX: LP XNT pool — lamports are only READ here (accumulator
update); no mut, so stakes don't write-lock the shared pool.

accounts.name: xnt_debt
docs: CRIT-3 FIX: per-position XNT debt initialized at stake-time. Plain
`init` — position_mint is a fresh keypair created in this same
instruction, so this PDA can never pre-exist.

accounts.name: lp_mint_config
docs: Appended LAST so existing clients only need to add one trailing account.

instructions.name: claim_lp
docs: Claim GUM rewards from LP staking — must hold the position NFT.
Pays from lp_reward_vault using Pattern B accumulator.

accounts.name: position_ata
docs: Caller must hold the position NFT — verified in instruction body

accounts.name: gum_mint
docs: The fixed-supply GUM mint

accounts.name: lp_reward_vault
docs: LP reward vault — transfer source

instructions.name: unstake_lp
docs: Unstake LP — must hold position NFT.
Partial: reduces position, keeps NFT. Full: burns NFT, closes account.
Early exit (before lock_until): per-tier penalty, of which 50% is burned
and 50% retained in the vault as deferred rewards. No GUM emitted on early exit.

accounts.name: position_mint
docs: Position NFT mint — burned on full withdrawal

accounts.name: position_ata
docs: Caller must hold the position NFT

accounts.name: lp_mint
docs: B2 FIX: must be the mint this position was staked with; vault_lp_ata
derives from it, so an unbound mint let a junk-mint position drain the
real LP vault.

accounts.name: gum_mint
docs: The fixed-supply GUM mint

accounts.name: lp_reward_vault
docs: LP reward vault — pending GUM rewards source

accounts.name: lp_xnt_state
docs: HIGH-1 FIX: XNT fee state — accumulator must advance on weight changes.

accounts.name: lp_xnt_pool
docs: XNT pool — settles pending XNT to claimer on full unstake; HIGH-3 sync on partial.

accounts.name: xnt_debt
docs: HIGH-3 FIX: xnt_debt is settled and re-snapshotted on partial unstake.

instructions.name: recover_legacy_v1_stake
docs: Recover an NFT staked under the v1 (pre-Phase-1) StakeAccount layout.
Reads the OLD 8+82-byte StakeAccount via raw bytes, transfers the NFT
from the OLD vault back to the owner, closes the OLD PDA. No GUM
rewards (v1 GUM PDA mint is no longer authoritative).

accounts.name: legacy_vault_ata
docs: v1 vault ATA — owned by legacy_stake_config, holds the staked NFT

accounts.name: user_ata
docs: User's NFT destination — created if missing

instructions.name: initialize_xnt_fees
docs: One-time admin call: creates the four PDAs that power XNT fee sharing
(two lamport-holding pools + two accumulator state accounts).

instructions.name: claim_xnt_fees_nft
docs: NFT staker claims their accumulated XNT share. Creates the per-position
XntDebt PDA on first call (lazy-init for legacy positions; new positions
have it initialized at stake-time so this path is mostly redundant).

accounts.name: xnt_debt
docs: Per-position debt — created on first claim

instructions.name: claim_xnt_fees_lp
docs: LP staker claims their accumulated XNT share.

accounts.name: position_ata
docs: Caller must hold the position NFT

instructions.name: sweep_xnt_pool_nft
docs: Admin: recover unattributed lamports from the NFT XNT fee pool while
NO ONE is staked (total_nft_weight == 0). Unattributed lamports come
from sources with no owner: fees absorbed while the pool had zero
stakers, shares forfeited by pre-XntDebt legacy positions, unpayable
remainders of closed positions, and accumulator rounding dust. With
zero weight there are no live entitlements, so the sweep cannot touch
any staker's share. Leaves the rent-exempt minimum in place and
re-baselines last_seen so accounting starts clean.

instructions.name: sweep_xnt_pool_lp
docs: Admin: same as sweep_xnt_pool_nft, for the LP pool (total_lp_weight == 0).

instructions.name: set_lp_mint
docs: Admin: register (or change) the single LP mint that stake_lp accepts.
Kept in its own PDA so the StakeConfig layout does not change. Existing
positions keep the mint recorded in their LpStakeAccount; changing this
only affects NEW stakes.

types.name: Auction
docs: English auction — NFT escrowed in the shared listing escrow; the highest
bid escrows as lamports in this PDA (refunded on outbid).

types.name: GumballSvg
docs: Separate PDA holding the on-chain SVG — not loaded by burn instructions

types.name: Listing
docs: Marketplace listing — seller lists NFT at a fixed price

types.name: LpMintConfig
docs: The one LP mint stake_lp accepts. Sibling PDA (seeds [b"lp_mint_config"]) so
StakeConfig keeps its layout. Written only by set_lp_mint.

types.name: MintRequest
docs: Pending mint request linking user payment to a commitment

types.name: Offer
docs: Marketplace offer — buyer bids on an NFT with escrowed XNT

types.name: OracleCommit
docs: Stores oracle commitment before randomness is needed — C-2 fix

types.name: SeasonConfig
docs: Seasonal trait window — while ends_at is in the future, new mints draw
flavor/color from [start, start+count) sub-ranges of the trait arrays.

types.name: XntDebt
docs: Per-position XNT debt — created lazily on first claim_xnt_fees call.
Sibling PDA to the v2 StakeAccount / LpStakeAccount so we don't have to
migrate existing positions to add a field.

types.name: XntFeeState
docs: Accumulator state for one fee-sharing stream (NFT or LP).
`last_seen_balance` lets us know how many new lamports arrived since the
last accumulator update, even though deposits happen out-of-band.

types.name: XntPool
docs: Lamport-holding PDA for a fee-sharing pool. Owned by the program.
Two instances:
nft_xnt_pool — accrues NFT-staker share of all fees
lp_xnt_pool  — accrues LP-staker share of all fees
